content: The 3x12sT screw is not listed on either Fasteners bag, but for me it was in the 2/2 bag. And you need only one of these screws in this step.
Why do I need another two 3x12sT? I still have one left from the left assembly, I guess it should be one screw each instead.

Copy/paste mistake - the INDX-PTFE-holder-cover is in the Filament holder right bag this time.

And only need 1x 3x12sT screw.
